notes:
**A partial-crawl report told you to re-run with a number too small to help.**
On a large directory site Docket read 999 pages, found 6,893 more it had not
reached, and then suggested re-running with a limit of 4,995 — less than the
7,892 URLs it already knew about. Following that advice meant waiting through a
second crawl and getting the same message back.

The suggestion was a multiple of what had been crawled. What decides whether a
re-run finishes is what was *discovered*, and Docket had that number all along —
it prints it two sentences earlier. The advice now names both figures, how many
URLs exist and how many were reached, and suggests a limit big enough to cover
them.
